caption: The drawing depicts a rectangular section of patterned fabric or wallpaper, dominated by a repeating botanical and avian motif. The background is a light, almost white color. There are multiple large, blooming flowers with layered petals in shades of pink, accented with lighter and darker pinks, and centers that are pale green and yellow. Various green leaves and stems branch out from the flowers in different directions, and small clusters of round green buds or berries are scattered throughout the composition. Interspersed among the flora are birds with outstretched wings, shown in profile. The birds are primarily pink, white, and green, with detailed plumage and extended tail feathers. A small butterfly with similarly light coloration is also present. All elements are drawn with a loose, brushy style that emphasizes soft color blending. Below the main patterned section, there is a small, rectangular color swatch that appears to echo the palette used above, featuring a mix of greens, pinks, and whites. The entire composition is set against a plain, off-white background.
title: Wallpaper
